question.text: When <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>10</mn><mo> </mo><mi>mL</mi></math> of an aqueous solution of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>KMnO</mi><mn>4</mn></msub></math> was titrated in acidic medium, equal volume of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>0</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>1</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">M</mi></math> of an aqueous solution of ferrous sulphate was required for complete discharge of colour. The strength of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>KMnO</mi><mn>4</mn></msub></math> in grams per litre is _______<math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>×</mo><msup><mn>10</mn><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>.</mo></math> (Nearest integer) [Atomic mass of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">K</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>39</mn><mo>,</mo><mi>Mn</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>55</mn><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>16</mn></math>]

solution.text:
MnO4-vf=5+Fe2+⟶vf=1Mn2++Fe3+

Mili equ. of MnO4=- mili equ. of Fe2+

5[M×10]=1[0.1×10]

M=0.15=0.02 mole  Lit 

Strength of KMnO4=0.02×158gramLit=3.16 g/L=316×10-2 g/L
